jobs.title: Executive Director - Department of Medicine
jobs.description:
**Description**
The Executive Director will provide direct support to the Department of Medicine Executive Administration. They will support the Chief Administrative Officer, department administrative operations, and strategic initiatives. The incumbent will also oversee areas of staff career development and engagement initiatives.


Annual salary range: 132,300\.00 \- 307,100\.00\. The department’s target salary range is 213,300\.00 – 220,000\.00

**Qualifications**
Required:* Bachelor’s Degree (BA, Health Care Administration, Public Health, or related field, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of five years Healthcare leadership experience along with an understanding of clinical, research, and education operations.
* Demonstrated strategic leadership, planning and change management skills in a highly matrixed environment, preferably a research\-intensive medical school/health system.
* Ability to demonstrate a high level of diplomacy in persuading and influencing a wide variety of people at various levels to achieve results.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and analyze all pertinent information/data to make and communicate executive level recommendations and decisions.
* Exceptional negotiation and effective interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to establish a culture of integrity and accountability.
* Advanced expertise in financial planning and analysis and decision support as it pertains to academic health care, research and higher education.
* Demonstrated skills as a receptive listener, influential and persuasive and seeks to understand the differing sides of each situation. Makes decisions effectively and decisively.
* Strong knowledge of industry standards, trends and regulatory requirements.
* Advanced expertise using computer software such as Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, database management and timekeeping software.
* Ability to use high\-level discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.
  

Preferred:* Education Master’s Degree (Health Care Administration, Public Health, or Related Field)
* Knowledge of academic and/or administrative structure of institutions of higher education.

jobs.title: Associate Director of Development
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**



Essie Justice Group (Essie) is building grassroots power to dismantle the US incarceration system, the most egregious creator of racial and gender injustice of our time. **We are a loving and powerful community of women with incarcerated loved ones.** Our community includes cisgender women, transgender women, formerly incarcerated women, gender expansive people, elders, and young people.

  

After twelve years of building an active membership across California and beyond, Essie is deepening its base\-building and leadership development strategies with the 1 in 4 women with incarcerated loved ones to propel bold decarceration agendas across the nation. We seek to transform the criminal legal system and create a Black feminist future rooted in care, equity, community safety, and liberation. **In the midst of significant organizational growth, we are seeking an impact\-driven and strategic Associate Director of Development to join our team.**

  

As Essie grows, the **Associate Director of Development** will take the lead in managing the internal operations for our philanthropic efforts to support our work to end mass incarceration and build a Black feminist future. We see our donors as partners in this work, and the **Associate Director of Development** is a thoughtful and deliberate steward of these relationships. The **Associate Director of Development** is a strategic fundraising leader who is comfortable getting into the weeds while also balancing the strategic development of the team. They excel at crafting clear and compelling narratives that connect philanthropic partners and potential donors to meaningful movement work, think empathetically about their audiences, and are deeply motivated by a belief in the leadership development and liberation strategies of directly impacted people.

 **Core Responsibilities**

 **Donor Program Design and Management** \- Help develop strategies and processes for identifying and engaging donors and nurturing and managing donor relationships.


* Partner with the Interim Co\-Executive Directors to establish benchmarks and goals for individual fundraising.
* Iterate and oversee development infrastructure internally, including CRM features and advising on key changes to roles and make\-up of our existing structures for stakeholder engagement.
* Evaluate and recommend new funding opportunities in alignment with Essie’s strategic priorities and programmatic work.
* Support in determining the key organizational accomplishments and aspirations we communicate in grant applications and reports.
* Lead the design and management of prospect research and relevant relationship management processes.
* Develop solicitation goals, cultivation strategies, and stewardship plans in a way that donors are respected, retained, and inspired to increase their support.
* Develop and implement engagement strategies including, but not limited to: telephone outreach, email/mail outreach, personal visits, and small group activities.
* Review and finalize grants and proposals.
* Develop strategies and manage implementation of donation appeals (digital or print as strategically identified) including seasonal appeals (ex. end of year/holiday giving) and complementary fundraising appeals matching Essie’s campaigns and policy fights.
* Track and report results of appeals and special campaigns, adjusting strategies as needed.

  


**Donor Relationship Stewardship \-** Manage and facilitate Essie’s ongoing organizational relationships with individual donors, ensuring that they remain engaged in and inspired by Essie’s work.


* Manage robust donor stewardship and cultivation touchpoints including personal thank yous, digital communications, and personalized outreach.
* Prepare and distribute materials to communicate with supporters including thank you letters, event reports, and annual reports.
* Ensure electronic donor records are current in the development database, including tracking moves for those within the major gifts portfolio.
* Advise and prepare senior leadership for donor meetings as needed.
* Manage the strategy and coordination of funder visits with Executive Leadership.
* Facilitate connective and grant reporting funder calls as identified.
* Lead the planning and management of donor events that combine political education and philanthropic action.

  


**Team Leadership** \- Manage and evaluate team members and processes for success.

  

* Co\-hold the container of the staff team and contractors to support day\-to\-day development operations and achieve set organizational goals together.
* Provide input on development process improvements, and work with teammates to refine collaborative systems as necessary.
* Work collaboratively and consistently with other leaders at Essie to define strategic priorities, make decisions about unanticipated opportunities, and manage towards operational plan goals.
* Manage departmental budgets and work systems, and co\-build and manage a dynamic Communications \& Partnerships staff team.
* Embody and promote Essie culture and values internally and externally.
* Directly manage 1\-2 staff members.

  


**Who We’re Looking For**


**Ideal Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of development\-related work experience, including experience with individual giving campaigns and direct responsibility for donor relationship development.
* Advanced experience managing a staff team and in creating and directing team\-wide strategy.
* Advanced experience in securing strategic partnership agreements to advance an organization’s mission.
* Highly organized with an attention to detail that ensures successful tracking, management, and engaged donor relationships.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to represent the organization and its work to donors as well as interface with a rich diversity of donors, volunteers, and staff while maintaining tact, diplomacy, and confidentiality.
* Impeccable attention to detail and

jobs.title: Consumer & Community Bank Strategy, Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

JPMorganChase's Consumer \& Community Bank (CCB) Strategy team is seeking a senior strategy leader to help shape and drive the multi\-year evolution of the Chase Product \& Technology organization. The Consumer \& Community Banking Strategy team supports strategic initiatives aligned with the bank's overall business goals.


As an Executive Director in the Consumer \& Community Banking Strategy team, you will drive the strategic vision and operational excellence for the Chase Product and Technology organization. You will work directly with senior leadership to define strategy, shape operating model choices, and lead high\-impact topics at the intersection of retail banking, product, technology, and AI\-enabled capabilities. Success in this role will be determined by your ability to drive strategic alignment on the operating models, influence senior leadership decision\-making, and develop a high\-performing team of strategists.


Consumer \& Community Banking serves millions of consumers and small businesses with a broad range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business lending, and payment processing. Customers engage across physical and digital channels, including a national branch network and digital banking platform. The Strategy team collaborates with senior executives and cross\-functional partners to shape direction, proactively evaluate strategy against competitive, consumer, macroeconomic, and regulatory developments, and communicate strategy to senior leadership and governance forums.


Job responsibilities


* Defines and drives multi\-year strategies to evolve product and technology operating models, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and constraints
* Monitors market developments (including by leading technology firms and AI labs), competitor activities, and regulatory shifts to refine strategies and execution paths
* Partners closely with the Consumer \& Community Banking COO and CIO to curate and deliver a high\-impact strategy book of work; partners with other members of the leadership team on select initiatives
* Collaborates with and influences key partners, including product leaders, technology leadership, finance, human resources, communications, and global technology, to support and execute strategic initiatives
* Builds and leads a high\-performing team to drive activity and deliver results
* Provides regular updates and status reporting to senior stakeholders, including the Consumer \& Community Banking CEO and leadership team, ensuring transparency and alignment
* Coordinates significant deliverables, ensuring timely completion and quality outcomes
* Crafts and delivers executive communications and presentations for senior leadership


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* 10\+ years of experience, including experience with a top\-tier strategy/management consulting operating at the Associate Partner / Principal / Director\-equivalent level, including leading large teams and partnering directly with C\-Suite executives
* Experience translating complex and technical topics for non\-technical audiences to support decision\-making and execution
* Demonstrated ability to learn new topics quickly and keep pace with a rapidly changing external landscape
* Proven ability to work with and influence a diverse set of senior executive stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively, developing partnerships across multiple levels
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment
* Executive presence and experience creating and delivering executive narratives and presentations
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Bachelor's degree


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills


* MBA or post\-graduate degree
* Experience advising on or leading digital / technology related projects, including including product \& technology operating models, data/AI, modernization, agile/ways of working
* Experience in consumer banking strategy at a large financial institution
* Knowledge of product and technology operating models, AI and digital transformation, and emerging technologies (especially in financial services)
* Demonstrated experience devising, mobilizing, and jumpstarting large, complex programs and strategic initiatives


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
New York, New York Category Operations Job Id P\-100170 Job Type Full Time $165,000\-$200,000/annual
  
**Job Requirements**  

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is accountable for all operational, financial, and administrative functions across the Company's global security, investigations, and consulting divisions. The COO serves as a key strategic partner to the CEO and Chairman, ensuring the Company's operations, infrastructure, and capabilities remain best\-in\-class and aligned with its long\-term vision.

  

**Responsibilities**


* Provide direct oversight of all global business units, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, and execution of same through identified performance objectives.
* Drive business development efforts, including cultivating new client relationships and expanding existing accounts, by identifying new opportunities.
* Ensure the Company’s operational infrastructure, systems, and capabilities remain modern, scalable, and aligned with its strategic vision.
* Directly oversee the General Manager, Controller, and Director of Administration; ensure effective leadership across all functional areas and maintain regular reporting to the CEO on key developments and risks.
* Establish, monitor, and enforce quality control standards and performance metrics across the organization.
* Lead organizational performance management, including supervision structures, training programs, and continuous evaluation of personnel and business unit effectiveness.
  

**Financial Oversight**


* Oversee the Controller and maintain full accountability for the Company’s financial management and health.
* Ensure adherence to GAAP standards and compliance with all regulatory, tax, licensing, and client\-specific financial requirements.
* Ensure compliance with all tax and regulatory filings, and all finance deliverables and obligations.
* Monitor and manage profitability drivers and closely manage overtime (OT) and lost hours across profit centers, ensuring alignment with budget targets.
* Maintain real\-time awareness of key financial indicators and provide ongoing briefings to the CEO and Chairman.
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all financial audits.
* Ensure that Controller briefs the Chairman and CEO weekly finance meetings and maintain readiness to report on financial performance at any time.
  

**Administrative \& Organizational Leadership**


* Oversee the Director of Administration and all administrative functions, including Human Resources, recruiting, compliance, and support services.
* Implement data\-driven, metrics\-based management practices to improve efficiency and effectiveness across administrative functions.
* Stay current on industry trends and best practices; lead the evaluation and integration of AI and other innovative technologies into Company operations.
* Oversee compliance with HR, licensing, insurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Define and drive organizational strategy, workforce planning, and hiring initiatives.
* Maintain authority over hiring, promotion, and termination decisions for management and staff roles.
* Collaborate with CEO and Director of Administration on RFP responses and negotiate contract terms to ensure commercially sound and profitable client and vendor agreements.
  

  

**Operational Leadership**


* Oversee the General Manager and continuously assess operational programs, policies, and procedures to identify efficiencies and implement improvements across all business units, and all business regions.
* Ensure client satisfaction across all engagements, maintaining accountability for client relationships and points of contact.
* Partner with the CEO and GM to establish strong client communication frameworks and proactively address client needs.
* Travel as required to support client engagements and organizational priorities.
* Manage relationships with teaming partners and joint ventures, ensuring appropriate operational, financial, and administrative controls are in place.
* Dedicate full professional effort, attention, and leadership to advancing the Company’s mission and interests.
  

**Core Competencies \& Expectations**


* Demonstrated leadership with integrity, accountability, and sound judgment
* Advanced understanding of business planning, operations, and regulatory environments
* Strong command of GAAP and financial management principles
* Proven ability to implement data analytics, KPIs, and performance metrics
* Decisive problem\-solving skills with the ability to anticipate and mitigate risk
* Proactive, hands\-on leadership style with a focus on motivation, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness
  

  

  

  

  

**Work Experience**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in criminal justice, business management or a related field
* Minimum of 10 years of Executive Managerial experience in the private sector
* Executive\-level experience leading complex, multi\-functional operations, preferably within security, investigations, consulting, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Proven record of translating strategic objectives into disciplined operational plans, measurable performance goals, and scalable business processes.
* Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, profitability management, audit readiness, GAAP compliance, and executive\-level financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior managers and cross\-functional teams, establish accountability, and build high\-performing organizational structures.
* Proficiency in using data, KPIs, operational dashboards, and performance metrics to drive decision\-making, efficiency, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to brief ownership, the CEO, senior leadership, clients, and external stakeholders on operational, financial, and organizational matters.

jobs.title: Director of Philanthropy, Sr.
jobs.description:
**THE BROWN** \| The Cici and Hyatt Brown Museum of Art, Science \& History

**Position Description:** SENIOR DIRECTOR OF PHILANTHROPY

**Reports To**: Chief Executive Officer, direct line. Dotted line to the Chief Operating Officer in partnership with the Executive Assistant, who provide shared administrative and cross\-departmental support.

**Classification:** Exempt, full\-time Director (Departmental) tier; individual contributor, no direct reports

**Department:** Philanthropy \- owns all institutional fundraising revenue

**Position Summary**

The Senior Director of Philanthropy is the Museum's senior fundraising executive, holding full accountability for every philanthropic revenue line: individual and major gifts, corporate and foundation partnerships, membership giving, special event fundraising, planned giving, and the annual fund. This is not a single\-program role \- it is ownership of the institution's entire philanthropy portfolio. The position reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer and operates as a senior individual contributor, personally building donor and funder relationships and executing strategy rather than managing a team. The role inherits and builds on the fundraising infrastructure, donor data, and three\-year development plan established during the Museum's transition period, and is expected to take full ownership of that foundation rather than start from a blank slate.

**Tier Classification**

This position sits within the Director (Departmental) tier rather than the Director (Operational) tier. The distinction is structural, not titular: Departmental\-tier roles carry a direct CEO or Board\-facing reporting line, full accountability for a revenue\-generating or mission\-critical function, and strategic rather than single\-function scope. The Senior Director of Philanthropy meets this standard through its direct CEO reporting line, Board\-facing fundraising accountability, and ownership of every revenue stream in the department, even though the role currently carries no direct reports.

**Organizational Hierarchy**

* Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer for strategy, revenue accountability, and Board facing philanthropy matters.
* Works closely with the Chief Operating Officer, who coordinates shared support resources across departments, including design, marketing, events, and the institution's data/database function.
* Partners with the Executive Assistant, who provides embedded scheduling and donor\-communication support to this role.
* Holds no direct reports. During the transition period, receives operational support from the Development Specialist and, once hired, the Database Administrator \- both shared institutional resources rather than reports into this position.

**Scope of Responsibility**

This role owns every philanthropic revenue line at the institution. Programs and campaigns will change over time; the categories below are intended to stay accurate regardless of how any individual program is named or restructured.

* **Individual \& Major Giving:** cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of individual donors at every level, from annual fund contributors through principal and major gift prospects.
* **Corporate \& Foundation Partnerships**: cultivation and stewardship of corporate sponsors and funders across all institutional programs and campaigns, not limited to any single event. Includes strategy and pipeline management for foundation and government grant funding, in coordination with contracted grant writing support where applicable.
* **Membership Giving:** strategy, cultivation, and growth of the Museum's principal giving membership tier and its broader membership program.
* **Special Event Fundraising**: revenue strategy and accountability for the Museum's signature fundraising events, including sponsorship, procurement, and net revenue performance.
* **Planned \& Legacy Giving**: cultivation of the planned giving pipeline and stewardship of legacy commitments.
* **Annual Fund**: strategy and execution of the Museum's core annual giving program.
* **Campaign Support:** donor relations and stewardship in support of active capital campaigns, in coordination with the Chief Executive Officer and any contracted campaign counsel.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute an annual philanthropy plan with defined revenue targets across every giving category above, in partnership with the CEO.
* Personally manage a portfolio of donors and funders spanning individual, corporate, and foundation relationships, including direct cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
* Own sponsorship strategy for all institutional programs and events, not limited to any single campaign, including direct outreach to corporate partners.
* Direct the Museum's grant strategy and pipeline across foundation and government sources, coordinating with contracted grant writing support on proposal development, submission, and compliance reporting.
* Lead the Museum's signature fundraising events, including sponsorship sales, procurement, budget management, and post\-event stewardship.
* Grow the Museum's membership giving program through structured cultivation, benefit fulfillment, and retention strategy.
* Establish and maintain a donor relations and stewardship system spanning all revenue lines, including gift acknowledgment standards, recognition, and planned giving cultivation.
* Assume ownership of the fundraising systems, donor data, and three\-year development plan established prior to this hire, refining and building on that foundation rather than rebuilding it.
* Provide philanthropy counsel and support to the President and CEO and the Board of Trustees.
* Report progress against revenue targets, across every giving category, to the President and CEO on a regular basis.
* Coordinate with the Chief Operating Officer to access shared design, marketing, data, and administrative support as needed.

**Success Measures**

jobs.description:
**About Us**

The Palestinian American Medical Association (PAMA) is a U.S.\-registered 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization established in 2013 by Palestinian\-American healthcare professionals. Our Washington, D.C. headquarters leads strategic fundraising, donor relations, and advocacy, while our country office in Palestine manages on\-the\-ground program implementation.

PAMA addresses critical healthcare needs in Palestine through targeted medical assistance, humanitarian aid, and medical education initiatives. Our core programs in Healthcare, Education, and Livelihood focus on enhancing healthcare capacity, supporting medical professionals, and fostering long\-term community resilience. Joining PAMA means contributing to a mission\-driven organization dedicated to improving lives through sustainable healthcare solutions.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Development is a senior member of PAMA’s leadership team, responsible for driving institutional and individual fundraising strategy, expanding PAMA’s donor base in key growth markets, and building the infrastructure to support a growing development operation. This role serves as PAMA’s lead for institutional fundraising, major gifts strategy, donor systems, and development infrastructure, while partnering closely with the Communications \& Events Manager, who leads communications strategy, event execution, and event\-based fundraising initiatives.

The Director of Development brings deep strength in institutional funding, major gifts, and donor data management, and operates with a high degree of independence and self\-sufficiency. This role will manage the Donor Relations \& Outreach Coordinator and Events Coordinator, providing leadership and professional development support as one component of a broader portfolio. The Director is also expected to be a skilled practitioner in their own right, personally managing a portfolio of donors, institutions, and conference\-based relationship development.

Candidates should demonstrate strong cultural competency and experience engaging faith\-based and values\-driven donor communities, particularly within the American Muslim philanthropic landscape, along with the ability to effectively build relationships with faith\-motivated donors and institutions.

This position will also exercise significant independent judgment in fundraising strategy, donor engagement, and departmental planning.

* Personally manage a portfolio of major donors and prospects, driving cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship through direct relationship management.
* Develop and execute a multi\-year fundraising strategy to achieve and exceed annual revenue targets, with a near\-term focus on growth markets including Florida, New York, New Jersey, California, and Michigan.
* Diversify revenue streams across individual donors, institutional grants, diaspora networks, corporate partners, and special campaigns.
* Collaborate with the Palestine\-based program team to develop compelling, impact\-driven proposals and donor materials.

**Donor Data, CRM, and Reporting**

* Serve as PAMA’s strategic lead for Salesforce utilization, reporting, and data integrity, including oversight of dashboards, CRM best practices, and staff training.

* Build and manage a conference engagement strategy as a defined pipeline for new institutional and major gift relationships.
* Coordinate with the Communications \& Events Manager to align conference participation with broader fundraising strategy.

**Team Leadership**

* Directly supervise the Donor Relations \& Outreach Coordinator and Events Coordinator, providing mentorship, goal\-setting, and performance management.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-accountability team culture within the Development department.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews; support professional development across the team.

**Cross\-Organizational Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Communications \& Events Manager to ensure fundraising strategy, donor messaging, and event revenue goals are aligned.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director and Board on high\-level donor relationships, campaign launches, and long\-term strategy, providing regular updates on development performance, pipeline status, and fundraising projections.
* Work closely with the Director of Finance to ensure fundraising activities, revenue reporting, and grant compliance are coordinated and accurately reflected in organizational financials.
* Work with Programs to ensure fundraising priorities reflect on\-the\-ground needs and programmatic impact.

jobs.title: Executive Director - NONPROFIT
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

Expected hours per week: 30\.

Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director (ED) is the chief executive of our nonprofit organization, **TeamUp! With Families, Inc.** (TU), and the key leader of its medical equipment lending library, **Katy's Kloset**. The ED will have overall strategic and operational responsibility for the execution and growth of the mission as well as overseeing fundraising, staff members, volunteers, programs, and sponsored family activities. The ED will develop deep knowledge of the field, core programs, operations, and business plans.

**OUR MISSION**

Our volunteer driven organization provides unique family\-centered activities that are physically inclusive and fun. Our medical equipment lending library, Katy’s Kloset, accepts and distributes donated durable medical equipment and supplies to adults and children at no or low cost.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Leadership \& Management:**

· Ensure ongoing local programmatic excellence, rigorous program evaluation, and consistent quality of finance and administration, fundraising, communications, and systems; recommend timelines and resources needed to achieve annual and long\-term strategic goals.

* Visionary yet execution\-focused leadership
* Strategic thinking with strong business acumen
* Ability to drive change and operational transformation
* Talent development and team building

* Unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and integrity


Requirements:  



**Education \& Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, or a related technical field required; MBA or Master’s degree strongly preferred.
* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing or industrial operations, with at least 5 years in a senior executive role.
* Proven track record of leading complex manufacturing organizations and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

**Skills \& Attributes**

* Deep understanding of modern manufacturing technologies, lean principles, and supply chain optimization.
* Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make sound business decisions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels — from the shop floor to the Boardroom.

jobs.title: Director of Development & Membership
jobs.description:
Lead fundraising, membership, and donor stewardship for a historic campus\-and\-community institution, the University YMCA.
Job Description
The University Y is seeking a mission\-driven professional to take an established development program to the next level. Building upon a strong and successful foundation, the Director of Development \& Membership will work closely with the Executive Director and Board in designing and executing a comprehensive development and membership strategy. Specifically, the Director will be responsible for managing all aspects of the Development program, including the Annual Fund Campaign, developing strategies to cultivate current or new membership, overseeing stewardship practices in the organization, planning fundraising events including the Dump \& Run program, developing planned gifts, and managing and directing major gifts campaigns. Additionally the Director will work with staff leadership to support grant application processes and specific programmatic fundraising initiatives.


Qualifications
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is required
* Requires a minimum of 3\-5 years of professional experience in development or a closely
  

related field.
* Demonstrated success in fundraising, working with volunteers and project management
  

is required.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) are needed, including the ability to speak in public, interact with and motivate donors, community leaders and staff, as well as to write compelling letters/proposals for support.
* An ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Possess essential computer skills and familiarity with donor databases such as Raiser’s Edge.
* Familiar, knowledgeable and comfortable with social media.
* Experience with grant writing is preferred but not required.
* Some evening, weekend and travel time will be required as necessary
Essential Functions
* Works with key constituencies (volunteer leaders, staff, students, alumni and community partners) in developing and executing Annual Fund campaigns.
* Writes fundraising appeal letters, stewardship and recognition communication, and grant proposals.
* Helps identify major donor prospects and strategies with staff and volunteers to create action plans that will lead to new or increased philanthropic commitments.
* Works with staff leadership to design and produce print, email and social media communication, recognition and training materials; and to develop analog and digital strategies for reaching and engaging supporters.
* Identifies prospects for planned giving and stewards current membership of the Y’s planned giving society, the Heritage Circle
* Investigates and develops new ways to integrate development and program initiatives that make the impact of our work more accessible and connected to our supporters.
* Oversees and coordinates the Annual Dinner \& Auction, Dump and Run® and additional fundraising events as needed.
* Evaluate and assess development activities making adjustments and modifications as needed.
* Maintain and update donor database and constituent records to facilitate good communication and segmentation practices
* Works with the staff and volunteer leadership to appropriately record, reconcile and audit all gifts to the organization; to produce and analyze reports as well as ensure accuracy, quality and process continuity of all development activities; to plan and execute an effective Development budget.
Cause\-Driven Leadership Competencies
* Philanthropy – Values and supports the many facets of philanthropy as an essential component in achieving our mission.
* Relationships – Builds authentic relationships in the service of enhancing individual and team performance to support our work.
* Communication – Listens and expresses self effectively and in a manner that reflects a true understanding of the needs of the audience.
* Influence – Employs influence strategies that engage, inspire, and build commitment to the cause and overall goals.
* Developing Others – Recognizes and acts on the need to continually develop others’ capabilities to attain the highest level of performance possible.
* Project Management – Supports goal attainment by prioritizing activities, assigning responsibilities in accordance with capabilities, monitoring progress, and evaluating impact.
* Quality Results – Demonstrates and fosters a strong commitment to achieving goals in a manner that provides quality experiences.
* Change Capacity – Leads self and others through change by navigating ambiguity appropriately and adapting well to new situations, obstacles, and opportunities.

jobs.title: Executive Director - Urology Services - Full Time
jobs.description:
The Executive Director, Urology Services, leads Elliot Health Systems (EHS) Urology service line across multiple sites, with responsibilities inclusive of the development and implementation of system\-level strategic plans, policies and procedures, and provision of overall administrative direction and coordination for the Urology, Urogynecology and Urologic Oncology Services across multiple practice sites (“Urology Services”). The Executive Director will have matrix reporting to The Chief Physician Executive \& SVP of Medical Affairs, and The Chief Nurse Executive \& SVP and a dyad leadership model working in collaboration with the Executive Medical Director of Urology Services. The Executive Director will collaborate with system leadership to accomplish strategic objectives for the Urology services and is accountable for providing operational leadership, financial, clinical, business development, care coordination, and standardization for the service line. The Executive Director is responsible for emphasizing consistency of standards and ensuring clinical and administrative “best practices” are communicated, shared, and implemented throughout the system. Provides strategic planning, direction and executive leadership for the development, growth, and advancement of patient centered care for all Urology Services for EHS.

**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Strategic \& Business Planning**

* Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive strategic roadmap that aligns with EHS priorities and advances system\-wide integration and excellence in care delivery.
* Ensures EHS is established and positioned for success in non\-traditional EHS markets. Provides direction and insight into regional trends across urology services settings, supporting EHS regional aims through recognition, coordination and cultivation of urology services opportunities and service delivery in EHS secondary service areas as an initial entrant in some cases. Participate in system\-wide strategic development and deployment of long\-term and annual goals.
* Maintain an in\-depth understanding of the value chain and episodes of care from access and diagnostics to delivery and post\-acute services and drive operational and financial decisions.
* Identify market trends, growth opportunities, and emerging technologies to guide service line evolution and differentiation.
* Explore strategic partnerships, affiliations, and service export opportunities to expand reach and community impact.
* Ensures services are clinically and financially sound and responsive to the changing health care environment locally, regionally, and nationally.
* Provides leadership to foster new business and pursue new program directions based on changing trends.
* Guide the development, expansion, and integration of new and existing programs.
* Ensure Elliot’s mission and vision to be your first choice to give and receive care and all areas of the 5Cs (i.e., Comprehensive, Confident, Coordinated, Convenient, and Cost\-Conscious) are deployed throughout the Center and adjacent service lines.
* Partners to implement digital health tools and innovations to enhance care delivery, patient engagement, and access for appropriate populations.

**Direct Operational Leadership**

* Provide administrative oversight of all Urology departments and programs, including staffing, performance, throughput, and care delivery optimization.
* Manage relationships and contracts for urology services with outside organizations
* Lead daily operations ensuring patient access, clinical workflow, provider productivity, and efficient use of resources.
* Ensure programs are designed and managed to reflect the full continuum of care and support optimal outcomes at every stage.
* Partners with EHS key stakeholders in driving standardized operations consistent with EHS policies and operational procedures supporting EHS’s strategic goals and outcome targets for patient experience, quality and patient access.
* Demonstrate constancy of purpose in embedding and sustaining the Elliot Management System.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational transparency through visible leadership and ongoing use of Lean management tools.
* Responsible for selecting and maintaining qualified personnel, identifying needs, recommending employee actions, and communicating the progress of plans.
* Develops succession planning and leadership development strategies for key clinical and operational roles to ensure long\-term strength and resilience of the service lines.

**Financial Responsibility and Resource Planning**

* Develop and manage operational and capital budgets services ensuring fiscal discipline and value\-based decision\-making.
* Oversee resource allocation, facilities planning, and capital investment planning to support sustainable service growth.
* Work with Revenue Cycle leadership to optimize billing and advance new revenue streams.
* Leverage clinical decision support and analytic tools to help clinical and operational leaders understand cost of care, contribution margins, and performance by DRG or episode.
* Collaborate with finance and analytics teams to ensure clinical decisions are informed by data.
* Ensure optimal care coordination, risk capture, and care model innovation to improve quality and reduce avoidable utilization and cost.

**Clinical and Quality Oversight**

* Ensures the consistent delivery of high\-quality services and programs that are responsive to the needs of patients, community, and providers and meet all regulatory requirements.
* Partner with clinical leaders to ensure delivery of high\-quality, evidence\-based, patient\- and family\-centered care.
* Advance continuous improvement, quality and safety initiatives, and consistency in clinical standards across the continuum.
* Ensure that the programs and services are fully integrated into the Elliot Quality Management System, with alignment to the principles of Just Culture and
